qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: World-class Tier-1 copper (Collahuasi, Quellaveco) and iron ore assets provide resource longevity and low cash-cost curves, but Anglo American is a pure commodity price-taker with zero pricing power over global market clearing prices.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (commodity price-taker & volatile sub-hurdle ROIC, REJECT). Despite premier Tier-1 mineral deposits, Anglo American is a pure price-taker on global commodity exchanges. Realized earnings and returns swing wildly with macroeconomic cycles, lacking pricing power >= inflation.
qualitative.evidence: Attributable ROCE and ROIC swung violently from ~26% in 2021 to ~5-9% in 2023-2024, driven by commodity price slumps, high cost inflation, and multi-billion dollar asset write-downs (De Beers, Woodsmith). Revenues and operating margins are dictated entirely by global spot commodity benchmarks.
